scope: All requested methods, controls and combined changes. Display selection fixed before trained-model DEV scores or Shpongle outputs. Seed0 is fixed, never chosen by results.

groups.title: Reference-guided capacity examples
groups.description: These use a separate video reference. Compare their color distribution; they do not test whether a model follows Shpongle.

variants.title: Accepted baseline C
variants.description: Your selected Rich96 baseline with generated palette history and 0.3-second transitions.

variants.title: Fresh Rich96 control
variants.description: Retrained alongside the new methods using the original visual descriptor. Use this to separate a method change from a fresh training run.

variants.title: Camera-cut filtering
variants.description: Training ignores color events near detected camera edits. The visual descriptor stays unchanged.

variants.title: Tracked person masks
variants.description: Training color targets use Cutie person masks, reducing the influence of people moving across the picture.

variants.title: Spatial color grid
variants.description: Training describes where colors appear in the picture, using an explicit spatial grid.

variants.title: Image-model features
variants.description: Training adds pretrained DINOv2 image features to the spatial color description.

variants.title: Image features through time
variants.description: Training adds a short history of image features, intended to describe how the picture develops.

variants.title: Combined training changes
variants.description: Combines camera-cut filtering, Cutie color targets, and the R3 temporal visual descriptor. R3 auxiliary features still use the original SAM masks.

variants.title: Combined + four color groups
variants.description: The combined trained model with a fixed palette split across four fixture groups. Group allocation is a design rule.

variants.title: C with two color groups
variants.description: The same baseline C decisions, with its palette distributed between left and right fixture groups.

variants.title: C with four color groups
variants.description: The same baseline C decisions, with its palette distributed across four fixture groups.

variants.title: Random image-feature control
variants.description: The audio model is trained, but its auxiliary image encoder has random weights. Tests the contribution of pretrained image features.

variants.title: Shuffled-history control
variants.description: Uses a fixed shuffled visual-history control during training.

variants.title: Reversed-coordinate control
variants.description: Reverses a fixed ordering of descriptor coordinates. It preserves information, so this is not a decisive test of temporal understanding.

variants.title: Reference-guided global color
variants.description: One shared color assignment chosen using a separate reference video.
variants.notice: Reference-guided illustration, not an audio-learned model. Only 1:50–2:54 was optimized; the first/last group choices are carried outside that interval while C supplies palette changes.

variants.title: Reference-guided two groups
variants.description: Two color-group assignments chosen using the same reference information.
variants.notice: Reference-guided illustration, not an audio-learned model. Only 1:50–2:54 was optimized; the first/last group choices are carried outside that interval while C supplies palette changes.

variants.title: Reference-guided four groups
variants.description: Four color-group assignments chosen using the same reference information.
variants.notice: Reference-guided illustration, not an audio-learned model. Only 1:50–2:54 was optimized; the first/last group choices are carried outside that interval while C supplies palette changes.

variants.title: Permuted-group control
variants.description: Reassigns the reference-guided O4 schedule across fixture groups.
variants.notice: Reference-guided illustration, not an audio-learned model. Only 1:50–2:54 was optimized; the first/last group choices are carried outside that interval while C supplies palette changes.

variants.title: Different-reference control
variants.description: Uses a schedule optimized for a different source video.
variants.notice: Reference-guided illustration, not an audio-learned model. Only 1:50–2:54 was optimized; the first/last group choices are carried outside that interval while C supplies palette changes.

baseline_promotion: Only after a later user choice; this inventory does not change baseline C.
